initial_failures.resolution: Six new money-template cases tried to mutate the absent MMS submission-time field; limit those cases to applicable SMS templates. Three historical MMS precedence cases and two TCP/TLS cases expected no address diagnostic; assert the newly supported earlier Address-Data5004 with its exact quote instead. Production logic unchanged after this first run; corrected selection and subsequent acceptance pass.

Six new fuzz seeds exposed an inverted NUL predicate in the independent Address-Data test oracle inherited from the Address-Type oracle. Corrected the test oracle to require NUL, without changing production code; reran full pure/race and counted fuzz.
